Advisory Council on Historic Preservation 1522 K Street N.W. Washington, D.C. 20005
July 11, 1977
Mr. Marvin Siflinger
Acting Area Office Director
Department of Housing and Urban Development
15 New Chardon Street
Boston, Massachusetts 02114
ATTN: Environmental Clearance Officer
Dear Mr. Siflinger:
Thank you for your request of June 21, 1977, for comments on the environmental statement for the Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project, Cambridge, Massachusetts. Pursuant to Section 102(2)(c) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 and the Council's "Procedures for the Protection of Historic and Cultural Properties" (36 C.F.R. Part 800), we have determined that your draft environmental statement appears procedurally adequate; however, we have the following substantive comments:
To insure a comprehensive review of cultural resources, the Council suggests that the final environmental statement contain evidence of contact with the Massachusetts State Historic Preservation Officer and that a copy of her comments on the undertaking appear in the final statement.
We appreciate the opportunity to review your undertaking.
Singerely yours,
ISTON AREA IS II 36 AM"T IA DIRECTO
Myra F. Harrison Acting Director Office of Review and Compliance
